normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter is only meaningful as the input magnitude consumed by the core transfer logic and tax computation.
The recipient parameter selects the destination balance and tax branch inside the core transfer logic.
The sender parameter selects the source balance and fee/limit exemptions inside the core transfer logic.
The newOwner parameter exists solely to write the owner state variable in the ownership transfer function.
The wallet parameter is only used as the key toggled in the noFees exemption mapping.
The liqPoolAddress parameter is only used as the pool key registered in the liquidity pool mappings.
The _taxAmount local is an intermediate of the core transfer balance mutation and carries no standalone semantics.
The _transferAmount local is an intermediate of the core transfer balance mutation and carries no standalone semantics.
The _taxTokensAvailable local is an intermediate quantity of the guarded tax swap routine.
The path local is a transient argument array for the external swap call and should be absorbed into that operation.
